purpose: Evidence baseline for Phase 6 operator, valet, monthly, event, and airport parser/source discovery before partnerships.

sources.evidence_claim: ABM describes more than 2,000 parking locations in more than 230 cities and direct booking/rates on its public site.
Metropolis describes itself as the largest US parking operator, with thousands of North American locations and verticals including hospitality, aviation, healthcare, universities, and events/venues.

Parking.com exposes city and facility-style pages for daily and monthly parking; SP+ corporate pages also list valet, hospitality, airports, healthcare, universities, and events/venues as relevant operating verticals.
AirportParking.com describes airport parking comparison/reservation coverage across many airports with prices, distance, shuttle information, and services.
Platinum Parking describes managed parking across US cities and public monthly parking discovery.

LAZ public history and public-sector material describe a national operator with over 1.2 million parking spaces, 3,000+ locations, and 400+ cities; other public materials mention 1.6M+ spaces and 4,000+ locations.
Propark publishes national operator pages and city/facility pages that expose garage, valet, airport, healthcare, hospitality, event, and daily/monthly parking candidates.
Ace exposes find-parking and reservation flows, with strong relevance for California and event parking such as San Diego convention/event inventory.

REEF payment pages expose lot-number based payment flows and ParkMobile pages show Republic/REEF lot examples with prices, making this a candidate for lot-number payment enrichment rather than a master inventory.

Towne positions itself as an integrated parking and mobility platform; TA Associates describes Towne Park as one of North America's largest outsourced valet and self-parking providers serving 800+ properties.
Interstate publishes city-level location pages for Milwaukee, Minneapolis, St. Paul, Denver, Fargo, Indianapolis, and related markets with daily/monthly/event parking details.

Flash states 17K+ parking locations on its platform and 30K locations available in Waze through integrations, making it useful as a demand-network or partner-feed source rather than independent master data.

ParkMobile reports availability at two million spaces, 600+ cities and municipalities, and 140 colleges and universities; this is highly relevant for payment-zone enrichment where official city data includes zone IDs.

research_note: These sources are not treated as master data until parser specs, evidence capture, legal/ToS review, and dedupe rules are written. They are high-priority candidates because city open data alone cannot cover private garages/lots, valet, monthly, airport, venue, event, and operator-managed inventory.
